metadata.scope: T8/T12/ACME lead screw nut carriages, end support blocks, coupler housings, anti-backlash nut holders.

material_suggestions.notes: Low creep; use metal inserts for nut pocket if anti-backlash spring present.

material_suggestions.use_case: light-duty carriage blocks and end supports
material_suggestions.notes: Acceptable; add steel rods or rails to prevent flex under load.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined carriage plates for CNC Z-axis
material_suggestions.notes: Rigid; machine rod bores to H7 tolerance for LM8UU press fit.

standards_used.name: T8 lead screw standard
standards_used.applies_to: screw diameter, pitch, and nut OD
standards_used.note: T8: OD 8 mm, pitch 2 mm, 4-start, lead 8 mm; nut OD 22 mm, height 10 mm, 4×M3 on ø16 bolt circle.

standards_used.name: LM8UU linear bearing
standards_used.note: LM8UU: OD 15 mm, length 24 mm; bore = 15.1 mm H7 in printed carriage.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: T8 leadscrew nut carriage with LM8UU guide rods
main_features: two rod bores parallel to travel axis
design_rules: LM8UU guide rod bores are HORIZONTAL along X — use rotate([0,90,0]) cylinder at y=±rod_spacing/2, z=0.
T8 screw clearance bore is VERTICAL (along Z) — plain unrotated cylinder through full carriage height, centered at x=0, y=0.

T8 nut pocket is VERTICAL from the top face — translate([0,0,carriage_height/2 - t8_nut_h/2]) cylinder(h=t8_nut_h+0.2, d=nut_pocket_d, center=true). Pocket diameter must be larger than screw clearance bore (22.6 vs 9.5 mm).

Nut capture bolt holes (M3 for T8) are VERTICAL (along Z) on the bolt circle — for(a=[0,90,180,270]) rotate([0,0,a]) translate([nut_bolt_circle/2,0,z_nut_center]) cylinder(h=nut_h+4, d=3.4, center=true).
Nut bolt hole diameter = nut_bolt_d + thread_clear = 3.0 + 0.4 = 3.4 mm for M3. NEVER compute as thread_clear + 1.0 (= 1.4 mm, too small for any bolt).
Optional bottom relief: translate([0,0,-carriage_height/2+pocket_depth/2]) cube([carriage_length-margin, carriage_width-margin, pocket_depth], center=true) to save material.
Do NOT use minkowski(cube, sphere) anywhere. Use plain cube for outer block and plain cube subtraction for any interior pockets.
validation_criteria: two LM8UU rod bore cylinders use rotate([0,90,0]) at y=±rod_spacing/2
T8 screw clearance bore is unrotated vertical cylinder through full height, centered
T8 nut pocket is vertical cylinder near top face, diameter > screw clearance diameter
four nut capture bolt holes are vertical cylinders on bolt circle, d ≈ 3.4 mm
nut bolt hole diameter = nut_bolt_d + thread_clear (≈ 3.4 mm), never thread_clear + 1.0
no minkowski() used anywhere in the module
failure_modes: nut pocket diameter same as or smaller than screw clearance bore — nut cannot seat
rod bores missing — no linear guidance
nut bolt holes missing — nut not retained
nut bolt hole diameter = thread_clear + 1.0 = 1.4 mm — too small for any bolt
minkowski(cube, sphere) inner cavity inflates all dimensions and eats into walls
screw clearance bore rotated to X axis — screw must be vertical for this carriage type

constraint_checks.message: T8 carriage needs two linear bearing rod bores.
Nut pocket must be sized for the T8 nut OD, not the screw.
